preserved_exactly: setup cache (terrain, roughness, culverts, probe cells, rain index map, stage BC)
buckeye_primary_handoff.explicitly_not_changed: the domain is NOT re-scoped and the OPEN boundary is NOT modified. A smaller or repositioned Buckeye domain may be run later only as an explicitly labelled post-hoc sensitivity member, never as a replacement for this primary run.
buckeye_primary_handoff.gate: crosshost_equivalence.py advances the frozen checkpoint 600 model-s and compares SHA-256 of h, qx, qy and peak plus max_h, max_face_v, volume and probe count against reference.json. PASS is required before resuming; FAIL means different host arithmetic and the run must not be continued as the same experiment.
buckeye_primary_handoff.gate_self_test: PASS on the originating host (deterministic, verified twice)
buckeye_primary_handoff.bundle: handoff/buckeye_primary/ (scripts, Dockerfile, pinned requirements, reference hashes); the 21 MB data payload — frozen checkpoint, setup cache and forcing — is delivered separately as an archive
